text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends the installation of revised relocations for parking, standing, stopping and school bus loading zone regulations on Southlawn Drive in the vicinity of the Lynnwood Heights Junior Public School. These changes are recommended due to the approval of an unwarranted All-Way Stop Control that was recently installed at the intersection of Southlawn Drive and Belgreen Avenue.

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the north side of Southlawn Drive, between Bellefontaine Street and a point 50 metres west. 2. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the north side of Southlawn Drive, between Buena Vista Avenue and a point 50 metres east. 3. Rescinded the existing parking for a maximum period of 30 minutes in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday on the north side of Southlawn Drive, between a point 90 metres west of Buena Vista Avenue and Bellefontaine Street. 4. Rescinded the existing School Bus Loading Zone designation in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., on the north side of Southlawn Drive, between a point 86 metres east of Buena Vista Avenue and a point 62 metres further east. 5.
